text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay... The debut is officially out of the
way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I really let 'em have it, didn't I?!
Just
kidding.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So? How do you... think I did?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That was so fast! Someone's
excited.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's keep that up when we
decide
which race to take on next.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to know how you're envisioning
our future.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...My aim, huh?
choice_data_list: ちなみに、目標にしたいレースは？
choice_data_list_en: By the way, which race are you aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nahhh, do you think I have the right to
pick what
I aim for?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You can take the lead here. See, this is
where you
can show your training advice
skills!

Even before her debut, I felt that she
had
potential for medium-distance races.
She's great
at maintaining her position in
a race, only to
speed up in the final
stretch.

What's important now is figuring out how
we want
to approach the Classics. When
thinking about
where to go first...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, I see. You want to see how I do
in an
open race.
choice_data_list: 『若駒ステークス』を走らないか？
『若駒ステークス』を走らない？
choice_data_list_en: Why not run in the 'Wakagoma Stakes'?
How about running in the 'Wakagoma Stakes'?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. Let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying you want me to finish
third?
choice_data_list: いつも通りしっかり結果を見せていこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's deliver solid results, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: For the record, I don't particularly aim for third place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It just always happens to end up that
way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's also a monster out there that just

constantly wins every race...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Teio is doing. Which race
is she
going to compete in?

Tokai Teio debuted at the same time as
Nice
Nature. No wonder she is curious
about her. But...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. I'm just hoping that I
won't have
to race her.
choice_data_list: 何よりもトレーニングだ！
何よりもトレーニングだよ！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you're right. Let's get down to
business.

And so, we decide that her next race is
going to
be the Wakagoma Stakes!
